pipeline.modality: Fully human monoclonal antibody (IV; SC formulation in development)
pipeline.target: Latent myostatin (selective inhibitor of pro/latent myostatin)

indications.indication: Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA), ages 2 and older (Type 2/3 non-ambulatory)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 in non-ambulatory Type 2/3 SMA patients on SMN-targeted therapy; ONYX is open-label long-term extension
indications.trial_status: SAPPHIRE Completed (positive topline Oct 2024); ONYX Active, not recruiting; BLA submitted Jan 2025, received CRL Sep 2025 (third-party fill-finish facility issue); BLA resubmission and US launch planned 2026; MAA filed with EMA March 2025

indications.indication: SMA in infants and toddlers (under 2 years)
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 evaluating apitegromab in infants/toddlers <2 years who received SMN1 gene therapy or SMN2-targeted therapy
indications.trial_status: Recruiting; patient enrollment and dosing underway

indications.trial_design: Phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, ~60 patients ages 18-60 with FSHD1/2; 10 mg/kg IV Q4W vs placebo for 52 weeks; primary endpoint mean lean muscle volume change
indications.trial_status: Not yet recruiting; trial initiation planned mid-2026

indications.indication: Healthy volunteers (rare, severe, debilitating neuromuscular disease development; potential cardiometabolic/lean-mass preservation use)
indications.trial_design: Single- and multiple-ascending dose study in healthy adults
